metallicarts.guide.title: Guide
metallicarts.guide.welcome: The Metallic Arts: press M, then Guide. /metallicarts-survival guide also works. Powers need fuel or stored attributes.
metallicarts.guide.snapped: You survived a snapping event. Check M for any awakened innate Allomancy. This event cannot be repeated to regain stolen power.
metallicarts.guide.0: Start: mine the new ores in newly generated Overworld chunks. Craft a metallurgy table and choose its tabs to refine, alloy and shape metal. The README lists exact recipes and controls. Existing chunks do not gain new ore.
metallicarts.guide.1: Discovery: each character gets a once-only latent Misting/Ferring allocation. Default chance is 50% for each art. Survive at least 6 damage with 6 health or less to awaken Allomancy. At XP level 5, run /metallicarts-survival discover to reveal Feruchemy. Some characters have neither. These are configurable gameplay rules.
metallicarts.guide.2: Allomancy: prepare pure metal flakes and brew filled vials. Drink, then press M and select a metal to burn or flare. Owning a power does not create fuel. Stop burning to conserve reserves. Keyboard and mouse buttons share server validation.
metallicarts.guide.3: Feruchemy: hold one metal ring, bracelet, bracer or earring. Press F, choose a contact slot and equip. Store an attribute while accepting its real penalty, then tap the same mind later. Identity protects charge. Blank Identity while storing for unkeyed minds; unkeyed alone does not grant a power.
metallicarts.guide.4: Equipment: with two filled vials in opposite hands, /metallicarts-survival mix combines ordinary fuel. With two free charged unsealed Nicrosil ability cores, /metallicarts-survival bind makes a medallion; add a third the same way. /metallicarts-survival medallion 0 equips its cores in adjacent slots. Tap each core in F; use separate attribute minds for the borrowed powers.
metallicarts.guide.5: Advanced arts: P opens compounding and construct controls. Turn Intent ON for an action that consumes material. Compounding needs both arts, a charged held source and a compatible contacted destination; it consumes the whole source. H manages spikes. Player extraction requires host permission and donor consent. Construct recipes require actual prepared spikes, not empty equipment.
metallicarts.guide.6: Safety and recovery: Esc closes menus; vanilla Controls rebinds mod keys. Bandages heal one trauma level while still; Gold tapping also pays to heal trauma. Back up the entire world before upgrades. Do not copy charged items between worlds: canonical charge lives in world data. Hosts can audit owned references. God-metal recipes are experimental and disabled by default. See the README for limits and future work.

tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.iron: Iron pulls external metal. Drink an Iron vial, acquire Iron Allomancy, then select Iron in M. Target an external anchor and pull; light objects move toward you, heavy anchors move you. Invested and protected targets can resist.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.iron: Iron stores weight. Equip an Iron mind in F. Store to become lighter, then tap to become heavier; stored charge and contact are required. Weight changes recoil and carrying interactions, not the physical mass of every inventory item.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.steel: Steel pushes external metal. Toss a real coin with C, select it as an anchor and push. Recoil depends on both masses. Multiple users contribute to one force frame; speed and target caps still apply.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.steel: Steel stores physical speed. Storing slows movement/actions; tapping spends charge for greater speed. Increasing rates becomes expensive. Stop the source to end its modifier; it does not accelerate global server time.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.tin: Tin heightens senses and can cause overload. Burn/flare from M. Vision, hearing and supported sensory cues remain distinct. Open sensory settings to reduce visual/audio intensity without changing server costs.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.tin: Each Tin mind stores exactly one sense: sight, hearing, touch, smell or taste. Select the sense before creating a mind. Existing minds keep their type; hearing charge cannot pay for sight.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.pewter: Pewter enhances physical capability. Burn it during combat or movement, watch fuel and stop when safe. Supported strength/endurance effects disappear when their paid source stops.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.pewter: Pewter stores strength. Accept reduced physical capability while filling; tap for strength and supported carrying. B lifts supported blocks only when capacity, loaded-world and protection checks pass.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.zinc: Zinc riots an existing emotion in an aimed susceptible target. Choose the emotion on M’s Mental page. Influence accumulates, is resisted and can be noticed; it does not issue arbitrary commands.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.zinc: Zinc stores mental speed. Storing impairs supported analysis/actions; tapping improves cognition and prediction handling. It does not grant physical speed or perfect foresight.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.brass: Brass soothes an existing emotion. Aim within range while burning and choose the affected emotion. Opposing influences combine before clamping; protection and emotional resistance apply.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.brass: Brass stores warmth. Filling lowers body temperature; tapping releases stored warmth. Watch environmental temperature and avoid overshooting; the finite body model is a gameplay adaptation.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.copper: Copper makes a cloud that conceals paid Allomantic pulses and resists emotional influence. Cloud strength and the seeker’s strength matter. It does not erase ownership or make a player invisible.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.copper: Copper stores actual recorded memories. In F choose a coppermind, then K. Click an accessible record to store it and a stored record to restore it. Search/rename preserves its ID. Sharing moves one record to an explicitly consenting player.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.bronze: Bronze detects paid pulses, including short recent burns. Stronger concealment can hide them. Metal signatures and distance are cues; raw grants, Identity keys and private journals are never broadcast.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.bronze: Bronze stores wakefulness. Filling increases fatigue; tapping spends charge to reduce it. Sleep can recover fatigue. Storage, sleep and tapping have separate limits and are not infinite free energy.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.aluminum: Aluminum consumes internal metal reserves when burned. Use deliberate burn selection; ordinary and invested reserves are drained according to the documented policy. It does not grant new ownership.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.aluminum: Aluminum stores Identity. Full blanking uses storage rate four. Fill other minds while fully blank to make unkeyed content. Unkeyed means no Identity key; it does not automatically grant the ability to tap it.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.duralumi: Duralumin amplifies currently active metals and consumes their remaining fuel. Inactive powers are not activated for free. Review costs before combining it with expensive or dangerous effects.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.duralumi: Duralumin stores Connection. Supported relationships, regional familiarity and existing teams affect rapport. It does not grant permissions, impersonate accounts or universally translate invented languages.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.chromium: Chromium leeches internal reserves through actual eligible contact. The target’s ownership remains. Player PvP/protection and server-side contact checks apply.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.chromium: Chromium stores Fortune. Tapping changes supported Luck and suggests bounded loaded-world opportunities. A cue is uncertain and does not create ore, guarantee drops or choose destiny.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.nicrosil: Nicrosil forces an eligible target’s next active-metal burst through contact. It pays and consumes the target’s actual eligible fuel; it does not copy grants or manufacture Investiture.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.nicrosil: Nicrosil stores one specific owned ability per mind. Choose its type before creating it. Filling surrenders that typed access; tapping restores paid temporary access. Unsealed construction and medallions still preserve each core’s charge and type.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.gold: Gold shows alternatives based on your actual recorded history. K lets you review that history. Echoes are bounded visual interpretations; the mod does not invent another biography.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.gold: Gold stores health while accepting reduced health capacity. Tapping heals and can pay additional cure/trauma/emergency costs. A bandage is a cheaper ordinary option for bounded trauma. No limb or disease simulation is implied.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.electrum: Electrum predicts short uncertain movement/projectile branches. J requests a paid clear opening. Collisions and future player input can change outcomes; it is not invulnerability.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.electrum: Electrum stores determination. Filling weakens resolve; tapping improves supported adversity and emotional resistance. It remains distinct from strength and physical speed.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.cadmium: Cadmium creates a slow-time field around its original center. Leaving the radius ends it. Supported entities and processing clocks slow; general redstone, scheduled ticks and player physiology remain outside the local-clock contract.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.cadmium: Cadmium stores breath using finite air. Fill in a safe breathing environment, then tap underwater when needed. Charge cannot be spent twice, and the body’s maximum air supply still applies.
tutorial.metallicarts.allomancy.bendallo: Bendalloy creates a fast-time field around its original center. Overlap combines bounded rates, and claim access is checked for supported processing. It does not duplicate inputs or outputs.
tutorial.metallicarts.feruchemy.bendallo: Bendalloy stores nutrition from actual food/saturation resources. Tapping replenishes the finite body reserve. Food, charged metal and body resources remain separately accounted.
metallicarts.guide.7: Research camps are rare new-chunk shelters with a table, supplies and occasional god-metal samples. Follow the advancement tree. Camps do not replace old terrain. Rare loot and recipes are gameplay progression choices, not canonical origins.
metallicarts.guide.8: God metals: pure Atium, Atium–Electrum (Nalatium) and Atium–Gold (Malatium) are separate items. Crouch-use consumes one bead for a finite burn. Alloy access requirements and trajectory limits are documented interpretations. Malatium never exposes a private player history without explicit consent.
metallicarts.guide.9: Controlled splitting: stand on a Metallurgy Table in a dry permitted area, hold one Harmonium sample with Trellium offhand, carry eight blaze powder and use /metallicarts-survival split. The host must permit Lerasium acquisition. The catalyst remains. Dropped Harmonium reacts with water; it never destroys blocks or bypasses protection.
metallicarts.guide.10: Sharing: /metallicarts-survival sharememories toggles permission to receive a moved memory. In the coppermind menu turn Share ON and click your accessible record while aiming within three blocks at the recipient. /metallicarts-survival pastvision separately permits Malatium past echoes. Both are OFF by default.
